messages:
Mira Patel: Quick sync — we need to align vendor slotting + marketplace listing timing for the H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi waves. Can partners confirm any hard no-go dates in April-May? 

Kelvin Cho: H100 slots: vendor just told us a potential firmware freeze around 2026-04-20. That could block last-minute image updates. MI300: driver parity fix targeted for 2026-05-03 (may slip). B200: inventory looks ok for June. 

Sofia Alvarez: Noted. Do we know if vendor firmware freeze will affect our marketplace images (container tags / driver bundles)? Alex, marketplace lead times? @Alex Kim 

Alex Kim: Marketplace requires final image + EULA + compatibility matrix 10 business days before listing. If freeze is 2026-04-20, we need final artifacts by ~2026-04-06 to be safe (QA + legal). Also need customer-facing SKU descriptions from partnerships. 

announce-bot: Reminder: embargo-handshake tool has been updated: new `embargo_cutoff` field supported. See /tools/embargo docs. :bell: 

Mira Patel: OK — proposed mitigation: two tracks 
1) Primary announce window: 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-22 (post MI300 driver targeted fix) 
2) Fallback: smallwave H100/B200 announce w/ compatibility caveat on 2026-04-30 if vendor freeze slips. 

Kelvin Cho: Agree on fallback plan. Need vendor confirmation on the freeze margin (+/- 7 days). Also flag: Gaudi firmware team asked for additional perf tests; could add a 1-week delay. 

Ryan O'Neal: Legal needs final EULAs and OEM attribution strings no later than 2026-04-08 for primary; fallback requires them by 2026-04-22 (compressed review). 

Sophia Li: SI integrations — we should schedule a dry-run for integrators to validate driver + container images before marketplace push. Propose 2026-04-12 for Gaudi/H100 early validation and 2026-05-05 for MI300. Dry-run checklist: 
``` 
- image pull & runtime validation
- driver kernel compatibility
- KV-cache smoke tests
- sample inference pipeline (latency smoke)
- logging & tracing hooks
``` 

Sofia Alvarez: Can ops provide a small lab pool for the dry-run? We only need 4-6 nodes per vendor. 

Kelvin Cho: Yes, we can carve a 6-node pool for 2026-04-12 (Gaudi/H100) and again 6-node MI300 run 2026-05-05. Need provisioning tickets by EOD Friday. 

Alex Kim: I'll block marketplace devs for the dates and start the SKU template. Also need marketing copy sync — don't want overlapping vendor press weeks. Does anyone know vendor press calendars? 

Mira Patel: I'll reach out to vendor PMs for press windows. If vendor embargo collides with Nvidia event (late April), we should push to mid-May primary. 

Ryan O'Neal: One more legal ask: include the following attribution line in all marketplace listings: "Hardware vendor names and trademarks used with permission." Send me the vendor legal contact. 

Mira Patel: Action items: 
- Mira: collect vendor freeze confirmations & press windows by 2026-04-02
- Kelvin: provisioning tickets for dry-run by 2026-03-28
- Alex: start SKU templates + mark marketing hold dates by 2026-03-30
- Sophia: prepare SI dry-run checklist doc and invite integrators by 2026-03-29
- Ryan: circulate EULA timeline to partners by 2026-03-29 

Sophia Li: :thumbsup: sounds good — I'll ping the integrators after Mira's vendor confirmations. 

Alex Kim: :white_check_mark: will coordinate marketplace gating. 

Mira Patel: Thanks all. If vendors confirm earlier we can accelerate, but plan assumes MI300 driver fix and Gaudi perf window. Ping me in-thread if anything changes. :sparkles:
